audit.whatIsWrong: Zoe is addressed as 'he/his/him' across the full layer — tldr, winCon, ahead, breakdown.wave, dosFull[1].t, dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[0].t and the report entries that mirror them.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists zoe as female. The owner is 'you', so every third-person pronoun on the page refers to Zoe.
audit.corrected: All of them switched to her/she.

audit.whatIsWrong: Graded TRICKY 7/10 against a 54.72% win rate over 106 games and a chart that hands Neeko level 3, first item and two items.
audit.why: Zoe owns levels 1-2 and 4-5 on range and the bubble; Neeko owns everything from first item on, because Zoe is squishy and Portal Jump only moves her 575 and back.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, tone #e8b84b, diffRating 5.5/10; carry threat left at 7.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[0..6].side were all 'Skill' while content win reads Zoe/Zoe/Neeko/Zoe/Skill/Neeko/Neeko.
audit.why: Two layers, two answers on the same row. packet.levelChart matches the content layer.
audit.corrected: All seven sides set to the content values with every why rewritten in the same group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Portal Jump as something you wait out ('she has no escape once Portal Jump is spent'), never states what sleep actually does, and calls her W 'More Sparkles'.
audit.why: Portal Jump is 11/8/5s — at rank 3 it is back every 5 seconds, so waiting it out is not a plan; the answer is to root her, because 575 out and back does not escape a root. Sleepy Trouble Bubble (18s to 14s, 800 range) reduces the target's Magic Resist while asleep and DOUBLES the first damage that wakes them — that, not raw poke, is the kill pattern. Her W is Spell Thief; More Sparkles! is the passive.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5], enemyWin, the don'ts, and wants.foe[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Four content fields describe a 'dash' with W Shapesplitter; content 'early' says Paddle Star! 'one-shots your health bar from screen range'.
audit.why: Shapesplitter is a clone plus a move-speed passive — there is no dash. And the kit gives no one-shot figure; what Riot's text does say is that the missile deals more damage the longer it flies and can be redirected in flight, which is the actually useful warning.
audit.corrected: Dash language replaced with W move speed; the one-shot claim replaced with the redirect-and-ramp behaviour.

notes: The 'body-block the bubble with minions or terrain' advice is retained in breakdown.cooldowns because it was already on the page and is consistent with the kit, but Riot's DDragon text does not itself state that minions stop Sleepy Trouble Bubble — flagged in unverified. The MR reduction and the doubled waking hit ARE in Riot's text, which is what justifies the 'resistances-invalidated' interaction from the brief; I wrote that, not the kit's trueDamage flag, which the description does not support. Portal Jump's real cooldown (11/8/5s) contradicts the page's plan of waiting it out, so the advice is now to root her instead — 575 out and back does not beat a root. Zoe was misgendered as he/his/him in eight full-layer fields; all fixed. Ratings left untouched (scale not self-consistent across matchups); breakdown.feeding remains templated.
